Walls rush at you down a neon corridor. Each one has a gap. Be in it.

Hyperslot is a one-life arcade runner built for quick, intense runs. Drag your cube into the gap before the wall arrives, then do it again, faster, with a pounding techno soundtrack that speeds up with you. There is no finish line: the walls never stop getting quicker, and your score is how far you get.

EASY TO LEARN, IMPOSSIBLE TO MASTER
- Drag to slide one cell at a time, flick to dash to the wall
- Gaps slide, walls rotate, walls black out, and double, triple and quadruple walls chain together

Game Center leaderboards for friends and the world.

Mistakes such as collisions add penalty points. Speed alone is not enough. Learn when to brake, when to straighten up, and when to try a different approach.
